$comment: Area of interest definition for the Universität zu Köln — the sixth twin, and the FIRST built on Nordrhein-Westfalen geodata (PLAN §37). Köln is 3rd nationally at 47 238 students (DESTATIS GENESIS, WS 2024/25) and the largest university this project can reach: the two ahead of it are TU München and LMU, both already built. Getting here required a third survey authority, because NRW is where the German university system's mass actually sits — Köln, Aachen, Münster, Bochum, Duisburg-Essen and Bonn are all in this one state.

planQuality.source: tools/data/build_plan_quality.py — whole-cohort lecture days + slot desirability

$lensesComment: Declared only now that the data exists — 8131 generated rooms, 156 of them carrying bookings from the generated plan — and not before. `world.test.ts` enforces that a lens may only be named where its requirements can be met. `flow` is absent because Campus Flow is derived from a real timetable and Köln publishes none this project can read; `condition` is absent because no German university publishes its Sanierungsstau per building.

rooms.$comment: ⚠️ EVERY INTERIOR ON THIS SITE IS GENERATED. Köln publishes no floor plans this project has found and the indoor probe of 2026-08-07 found no mapped rooms, so plates are laid out inside the REAL footprint at the REAL storey count and every record is badged `generated`. What is real is the building: outline, area and floor count are all measured.
rooms.$codePatternComment: Lower case, because the identifier is ours rather than the university's — the same signal used at every generated site.
rooms.$heroBuildingComment: The WiSo-Gebäude — 9793 m² over EIGHT storeys, the tallest building on the campus and the whole of WISO's home. Chosen over the larger Hauptgebäude (11 486 m²) for the reason LMU's config gives: the hero should belong to a MODELLED faculty, so that exploding it shows a plan somebody in the demo is actually responsible for. Eight storeys also makes it the best subject for the exploded view of any building on this flat, wide campus.
rooms.$storeyHeightComment: ASSUMED. LoD2 gives building heights but not floor-to-floor pitch. ⚠️ It matters more here than elsewhere: eight storeys multiply the error eight times, and the WiSo-Gebäude is the building the demo opens on.

referenceSemester.$comment: One representative teaching week from the GENERATED plan, not a real semester. The customary North-Rhine-Westphalian Wintersemester teaching period, not a date Köln has published.

bbox.$comment: HIGH-RESOLUTION CORE, ~2.15 x 1.64 km. Taken from the campus cluster find_campus_areas.py resolved out of OpenStreetMap (config/campus-candidates.json, HS111: 11 areas around Albertus-Magnus-Platz) plus ~250 m of margin. This is the Lindenthal Hauptcampus — the Philosophikum, Hörsaalgebäude, Seminargebäude, Mensa and the science institutes along Zülpicher Straße. The medical campus and the outlying institutes are NOT in this box; Köln's second resolved cluster is a 40 x 10 m fragment and was not worth widening the AOI for.

shell.$comment: COARSE TERRAIN SHELL, ~18.9 x 18.9 km. Holds the Rhine, the Innenstadt and the Ville ridge west of the city. ⚠️ Expect this shell to do LESS work than Tübingen's: the Cologne Bight is close to flat, so the horizon here is made of buildings rather than of terrain. The shell is still needed — without it the core would end in a cliff — but nobody will point at it.

elevationRangeM.$comment:
MEASURED 2026-08-07 by build_terrain.py over the core: 40.42 .. 65.21 m, from 6 Geobasis NRW DGM1 tiles at 100% coverage (grid 1099 x 849 at 2 m). Left slightly loose around the measurement so a re-run after a NRW update does not trip the plausibility gate over a decimetre.

⚠️ 25 METRES OF RELIEF ACROSS THE WHOLE CORE — the flattest AOI in this repo by some distance (FAU 36 m, OTH ~78 m, Tübingen 127 m). The hypsometric ramp is doing almost nothing here and the terrain shading has nothing to shade; what makes this twin readable is the buildings and the drape. That is a fact about the Cologne Bight, not a defect in the build, and it is written down so nobody 'fixes' the terrain later.

Ground heights at the resolved focus places came out at Humanwissenschaftliche Fakultät 49.3 m and Köln Süd 55.4 m — plausible, and a second confirmation that the focus coordinates landed on the campus.

drape.$comment: Long side of the DOP mosaic, via the Geobasis NRW WMS (layer nw_dop_rgb, 10 cm source). NOT larger: at 8192 px the mipmap chain is ~300 MB, which Chromium accepts and then silently samples BLACK.

grids.$comment: Geobasis NRW DGM1 source, resampled to a 2 m heightmap, mesh decimated 2x -> 4 m posting. The same tier as every other AOI here. ⚠️ Unlike Baden-Württemberg, NRW publishes DGM1 already as a float32 GeoTIFF with the ModelTiepoint/ModelPixelScale pair build_terrain.py reads, so there is no conversion step between the download and this grid.

shellGrids.$comment: Copernicus GLO-30 -> ~90 m posting. transitionBandM is written in metres for readability but MUST be applied as a fraction of the core (CORE_FADE_FRACTION ~0.08), never absolute.

campuses.anchorSource: measured centroid of the 79 features that single-linkage clustering at 350 m puts on this campus (probe of 2026-08-21, temp/koeln-probe-sites.json). Agrees with OSM relation/8727202 'Universität zu Köln' (amenity=university, measured extent 1704 x 1434 m) to within 200 m.
campuses.$bboxComment: ~1478 x 1069 m. MEASURED extent of the cluster (W6.92113 E6.93728 S50.92352 N50.93071) plus ~200 m of margin. This is the contiguous block the whole university is famous for: Hauptgebäude, Hörsaalgebäude, Philosophikum, Seminargebäude, the Mathematisches Institut and the UniMensa, all within 800 m of each other. Köln is the FLATTEST and most concentrated of the twins.

campuses.anchorSource: midpoint of the two measured northern groups: the Humanwissenschaftliche Fakultät at 50.93424/6.92140 (6 features, incl. way/125014714 and relation/12107246 'Humanwissenschaften') and the law institutes at 50.93457/6.91407 (6 features).
campuses.$bboxComment: ~1128 x 512 m, from the core's western edge to just short of the main campus. ⚠️ TWO GROUPS IN ONE BOX, AND THE NAME SAYS SO. They are 510 m apart — closer to each other than either is to the main campus — and neither is large enough to carry a campus of its own, but calling the pair 'Gronewaldstraße' would have promoted one of them and hidden the other. What matters for the scheduler is that both sit ~1.05 km north of the Hauptcampus across Lindenthal, which is the walk a cohort would have to make.

campusSeparation.$comment: MEASURED between the two anchors. The SHORTEST separation of any twin in this repository — OTH 2.48 km, LMU 2.44 km, FAU 2.88 km, RWTH 1.72 km — and it is included rather than dropped because a 1.05 km walk is exactly the ambiguous case: about thirteen minutes, so it fits in a 15-minute break only if nothing goes wrong, and not at all if the two blocks are back to back. A constraint that is obviously violated teaches nothing; this one has to be computed.

ownership.$comment: HOW A BUILDING IS RECOGNISED AS UNIVERSITÄT ZU KÖLN. This site is the easiest of the five because the university states its membership in TWO ways OSM understands — a site relation and an operator tag — and because the competing institutions in Köln (TH Köln, the Deutsche Sporthochschule, the Kunsthochschule für Medien) are all somewhere else in the city rather than in the same streets.
ownership.$outlineIdsComment: relation/8727202, amenity=university, measured extent 1704 x 1434 m — a real bounded estate rather than a claim over the district, so a point-in-polygon test against it is safe. relation/3472110 ('Hauptgebäude Universität zu Köln', 137 x 236 m) is a single building and is deliberately NOT here: an outline that is one building tests almost nothing and reads as though it tests a campus.
ownership.$siteRelationsComment: MEASURED: relation/1253808 is tagged type=site + amenity=university. ⚠️ ITS OWN BOUNDS (W6.93037 E6.93899 S50.91779 N50.92670, 604 x 990 m) SIT SOUTH-EAST OF THE MAIN CAMPUS AND MOSTLY OUTSIDE THIS CORE, which looks wrong until you remember what a site relation is: a MEMBERSHIP LIST, not an outline. Its bounding box is wherever its members happen to be, and it is read here for the ids it claims, never as a polygon. relation/12550583 ('Philosophische Fakultät', also type=site) is a faculty rather than the university and is left out.

indoorProbe.$comment: ⚠️ Named `indoorProbe` and NOT `rooms` — in this engine a `rooms` block MEANS real indoor geometry exists and drives the hero-building explode. Nothing has been found for Köln, so buildings stay solid and the app says so rather than inventing interiors.

$focusPlacesComment:
Resolved 2026-08-07 from OpenStreetMap via Overpass BY TAG — `amenity=university`, `building=university`, university-operated buildings, libraries and stations inside the core box — and not by name, for the reason Tübingen's config records at length.

⚠️ TWO DIFFERENT OSM RELATIONS ARE BOTH NAMED 'Universität zu Köln': relation/8727202 at 50.92854/6.92575, which is the Hauptcampus and is used above, and relation/1253808 at 50.92225/6.93468, roughly 600 m south-east. Picking by name alone is a coin toss between them. The one above was chosen because it sits inside the resolved campus cluster; the other is recorded here so the next person does not 'fix' it.

geobasis.$comment:
The THIRD survey authority in this repo, after the Bavarian LDBV and Baden-Württemberg's LGL. pipeline.py's `in_nordrhein_westfalen` predicate keys on the string 'Geobasis NRW' here to select the NRW steps, so this field is load-bearing and not decoration.

⚠️ dl-de/ZERO-2-0, not by-2-0: NRW places its geobasis data in the public domain and requires no attribution at all. The attribution is given anyway — every other source in this app is credited, and a licence that permits silence is not a reason to be silent about where a campus came from.

shellGeobasis.attribution: produced using Copernicus WorldDEM-30 © DLR e.V. 2010–2014 and © Airbus Defence and Space GmbH 2014–2018 provided under COPERNICUS by the European Union and ESA; all rights reserved
shellGeobasis.$attributionComment: The ADAPTED-DATA form of the notice, which is prescribed rather than stylistic: the pipeline resamples the tile onto a UTM grid and shifts it onto the core's vertical datum.
shellGeobasis.$tilesComment: FOUR tiles. The shell runs 50.845-51.015 N and 6.79-7.06 E, so it crosses BOTH the 51 N parallel and the 7 E meridian — the same four-corner case as OTH Regensburg. A missing tile does not raise an error; it renders as a flat shelf across that side of the horizon.
